title: Unequal opposite-charge modes admit an exact bare-energy normal form without harmonic-electric variation

bare_energy_normal_form.mode_moments: Define M=sum_k(w_(+,k)+w_(-,k)) and D=sum_k k(w_(+,k)-w_(-,k)), with w_(sigma,k)=|phi_(sigma,k)|^2.
bare_energy_normal_form.signed_work: Without equal-amplitude pairing, the exact summed work is H_a'=-e dot(a) dot D+e^2 dot(a) dot a M.
bare_energy_normal_form.energy_expansion: Expanding |k minus_or_plus e a|^2 gives H_a=E_0-e a dot D+(e^2/2)|a|^2M, where E_0=(1/2)sum[|dot phi|^2+(m^2+|k|^2)|phi|^2].
bare_energy_normal_form.normal_form: Exactly E_0=H_a+e a dot D-(e^2/2)|a|^2M and E_0'=e a dot D'-(e^2/2)|a|^2M'; no dot(a) term remains.
bare_energy_normal_form.same_tier_bound: For m>0, |D'|<=2E_0 and |M'|<=2E_0/m, hence |E_0'|<=[2|e||a|+(e^2/m)|a|^2]E_0 with no spatial derivative loss.
bare_energy_normal_form.scope_guard: The exact correction removes harmonic-electric total variation but still spends holonomy amplitude. It supplies no global integrability, scattering, nonlinear curvature/current control or positive limiting analytic radius.
